title: Cognoscenti: A Benchmark for Trustworthy AI Memory
description:
Cognoscenti is a benchmark for probabilistic, non-deterministic AI memory. It scores memory behavior along three axes of trustworthiness — calibration (does stated confidence mean anything), stability (does it agree with itself when repeated), and scope (does it respect the boundaries it's told) — through a deterministic, seeded stream-eval harness with an ACT-R reference, five stability tests, and token accounting for a learning-vs-static tokens-over-time hypothesis. No live run against a vendor or Achiral system has been published yet; the Measurement framework diagrams in the README are schematics of the method, not results.

Public benchmark page: https://achiral.ai/benchmarks/ai-memory-benchmark
Figshare preprint and reproducibility bundle (pre-dates this version's trust-axis framing; a refreshed preprint is pending): https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.33288195
